content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have the following hardware: [product_name]: [article_no], [product_name]: [article_no], and [product_name]: [article_no]. I also have this software: [article_no]. My questions are: 1- Is it permitted to upgrade the mentioned software ([article_no]) from [version_no] to [version_no]? If yes, could you share a download link? 2- Is the extension IO module [article_no] compatible with the CPU [article_no]? 3- I need a manual to learn how to configure [product_name] [article_no]. best regards, [user_name]

1) Yes, you can upgrade. However, a download link for [version_no] is no longer available; only one for [version_no] can now be found. You may use [version_no] for [product_name] [version_no]. Refer to installation instructions for [product_name] Upgrade [version_no]. 2) Yes, those modules are compatible. 3) There is no manual for the operator device, since it is not programmable. The operator device simply displays message texts programmed in [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about the legal aspects of upgrading software, compatibility between hardware modules, and how to obtain manuals or resources for configuring operator devices. Upgrading the software version and confirming hardware compatibility are main concerns, while the lack of documentation for specific operator panels is noted—especially the absence of a manual for the operator device.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear information on whether upgrading software is allowed and how to do so, confirmation of hardware compatibility, and access to manuals or configuration guides for operator devices.
